headline: Japan Core Consumer Inflation Rises 2.2% in October, Below Forecasts
summary: Japan's core consumer price index, which excludes fresh food, rose 2.2% year-on-year in October, up slightly from 2.1% in September but below market expectations.
why: The Bank of Japan closely monitors core CPI to determine the timing and pace of further interest rate normalization.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Core inflation printing slightly below expectations alters expectations for Bank of Japan rate hikes.
